cohort: 18,255 patients >18 years old who underwent abdominal, vaginal, laparoscopic, or robotic hysterectomy for benign or malignant indications from July 2012 through February 2015.
finding: The use of prophylactic cefazolin plus metronidazole resulted in lower surgical site infection rates after hysterectomy compared with cefazolin or second-generation cephalosporin.
